answer: Require bar admission per identity, verified against the state bar roll after character review and exams. Each fake needs a real admitted attorney, costing years of law school and bar fees; a sparrow cannot fake that record. The bridge between identity and licence is the public roll, so a forged admission is caught at enrolment, and every extra fake needs another admitted lawyer, so the cost rises per fake, and the ridge is that the roll is public: duplicates are visible to everyone.
